title: Efficient query execution for ontology-based databases

source_provenance.note: Ephemeral request-token parameters are intentionally not persisted.

publicly_described_functional_concepts: receiving an ontology query from an authorized user account
transforming ontology-level requests into backend database queries
selecting among graph, relational, indexed, compressed, or other representations of ontology data
estimating aggregation or join cost while considering the data visible under the requesting user's permissions
routing expensive operations to a high-performance distributed execution environment
transforming backend results back into ontology-level results

scope_model.analysis_loop: receive authorized ontology query -> resolve ontology types and permissions -> generate candidate backend queries -> estimate join/aggregation cost after access filtering -> select backend and execution tier -> execute -> normalize result to ontology objects -> record plan and performance telemetry
building_patterns_relevant_to_independen: keep ontology semantics independent from physical database layout
include authorization-filtered cardinality in cost estimation
support multiple backend representations through explicit adapters
route expensive plans to scalable compute only after deterministic policy validation
record model/schema versions, chosen plan, estimated cost, actual cost, and result provenance
keep write/mutation paths separate from read optimization

independent_claim_themes: ontology query transformed into backend queries
access-aware estimation of aggregation/join processing cost
routing expensive exact operations to optimized nodes
transforming results back to ontology data
